questions.question: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?
questions.evidence: annual average consumption of customer with the lowest consumption in each segment = total consumption per year / the number of customer with lowest consumption in each segment; Difference in annual average = SME's annual average - LAM's annual average; Difference in annual average = LAM's annual average - KAM's annual average; Year 2013 can be presented as Between 201301 And 201312; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) , CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) , CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Consumption = ( SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth ) AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
questions.generated_sql:
WITH annual_customer AS (
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS annual_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y
      ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
), segment_minimums AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        MIN(annual_consumption) AS minimum_consumption
    FROM annual_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
), segment_averages AS (
    SELECT
        a.Segment,
        AVG(a.annual_consumption) AS annual_average
    FROM annual_customer AS a
    JOIN segment_minimums AS m
      ON m.Segment = a.Segment
     AND m.minimum_consumption = a.annual_consumption
    GROUP BY a.Segment
)
SELECT
    'SME - LAM' AS comparison,
    sme.annual_average - lam.annual_average AS difference
FROM segment_averages AS sme
JOIN segment_averages AS lam
  ON lam.Segment = 'LAM'
WHERE sme.Segment = 'SME'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'LAM - KAM' AS comparison,
    lam.annual_average - kam.annual_average AS difference
FROM segment_averages AS lam
JOIN segment_averages AS kam
  ON kam.Segment = 'KAM'
WHERE lam.Segment = 'LAM'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'KAM - SME' AS comparison,
    kam.annual_average - sme.annual_average AS difference
FROM segment_averages AS kam
JOIN segment_averages AS sme
  ON sme.Segment = 'SME'
WHERE kam.Segment = 'KAM';

columns: CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)

questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGM NOT BETWEEN 40 AND 400 GROUP BY T1.Diagnosis ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT p.Diagnosis, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.IGM <= 40 OR l.IGM >= 400
GROUP BY p.Diagnosis
ORDER BY patient_count DESC, p.Diagnosis
LIMIT 1;

ambiguity.assumption: Identify the primary diagnosis occurring most often among distinct patients whose laboratory IGM level is <= 40 or >= 400.

questions.question: How many female patients were given an APS diagnosis?
questions.evidence: female refers to SEX = 'F'; APS diagnosis refers to Diagnosis='APS'
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS'
